program_name: Psychology
deadline_text_verbatim: On April 15, 2026 you will receive a message via Studielink about the ranking number assigned to you and whether you can directly accept the place (ranking number 1-700) or whether you will be on the waiting list (all ranking numbers above 700).
limitations: This date has already passed as of retrieval (2026-08-21). NOT a submission deadline for the student — it is the date Tilburg/Studielink issues the selection outcome. researcher_notes: Once notified, an accepted candidate (ranking 1-700) must accept their proof of placement within 14 days of receiving it, or it expires by law and passes to the next-ranked waiting-list candidate — a relative (not absolute-date) rule, not separately recorded as its own deadline row since it does not fit the deadline_date/recurrence contract (no fixed day/month, and the trigger date itself varies per candidate).
